picks.editorial_note: Purdue leads two of the first-ever DOE Genesis Mission awards, a flagship national initiative to accelerate scientific discovery with AI — signaling how deeply AI is now embedded in U.S. big-science infrastructure like the Electron-Ion Collider.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub at Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI could meaningfully speed up drug development timelines, a rare direct line from AI research to clinical translation.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's Jason Zhang is using generative AI to design proteins that don't exist in nature, extending Nobel laureate David Baker's protein-engineering breakthroughs toward novel therapeutics and materials.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model analyzes spatial proteomics across many cancer types at once, a step toward AI systems that generalize across tumor biology rather than being trained cancer-by-cancer.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: HKU's RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — the kind of standard-setting work that shapes an entire subfield.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's Genesis Mission-funded work applies AI to quantum computing error correction, one of the hardest open problems standing between today's quantum hardware and practical use.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's DOE-funded, Fermilab-partnered project applies AI to sift massive particle-physics datasets, illustrating how national labs and universities are jointly betting on AI to keep pace with exponentially growing experimental data.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot's billion-dollar valuation as TUM's 23rd unicorn is a concrete financial marker of how quickly university-spawned AI agent startups are scaling.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-backed collaboration with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida to guide healthcare workers through procedures via AI and smart glasses points toward AI directly augmenting frontline clinical care.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: A Nature Medicine study from UCL, Oxford, and the UK AI Security Institute introduces a clinically validated framework for auditing mental-health risks in AI chatbot conversations, directly relevant as regulators grapple with chatbot safety.
picks.title: Mapping how mental health risks emerge in AI chatbot conversations
